income_model_note: CLAS operates under three contract types: master leases (fixed/variable rent), management contracts with minimum guaranteed income (MCMGI), and management contracts (no minimum guarantee). 'Gross profit' is the disclosed income metric; 'NPI' is not used — gross profit plays NPI's role per trap #18. FY2025: master leases 27% of gross profit, MCMGI 24%, management contracts 49% (of which hospitality 35%, living sector 14%). Stable income (master leases + MCMGI + living sector) = 65% of gross profit; growth income (mgmt contracts of SR/hotels) = 35%.
